title: client_config.kids.requests
description: “Can I have more time?” on a child device. enabled = at least one family manager of this child or an admin notification target for kids_release_requested exists and the admin did not switch requests off; otherwise the app hides the button. open = own open request (also after a restart of the app). next_allowed_at = cooldown after a No or the hourly limit. recipients = who gets a request right now: the hub sends client_config_updated to the child whenever the list changes (a babysitter's access opens or closes, it connects or leaves, a rename).

recipients.description: Who gets a request of this child now, for “Dad and Mum will get your question.”: every family manager of the child (role family_manager) and every active babysitter (role babysitter: rule babysitter_requests, access open right now, connected to the hub = at home; docs/access.md). Family managers first, then babysitters, each sorted by name; the same name only once per role. Empty = nobody can answer by name (the app says “a grown-up”).

name.description: First name (owner label), else the device name.
